name: com.azzazello.aibt
description: Deterministic behavior-tree authoring, compilation, and reference execution for Unity.

samples.description: BehaviorTreeAgent with standard aibt.unity nodes and one custom C# node: a guard that patrols, chases and returns, a wanderer and a scout.
NativeTreeAgent with a Burst node in the short AIBT.Native form, a generated catalog, an Editor-prepared runtime asset, facts, effects and live graph debugging.
Condition and asynchronous Action nodes using only the public generated Burst API.
Readable production-node trees with saved graph layouts.
Low-level native path: one reactive tree for many agents through ProductionTreeHost and ProductionTreeWorld (patrol, pursuit, danger avoidance, cooldown attack).
